DERMAL FILLERS
Dermal fillers are injectable substances used to fill in wrinkles, lines, and hollow areas of the face, restoring volume and smoothing out the skin. They are typically made from hyaluronic acid, a substance found naturally in the body, or other biocompatible materials. Dermal fillers can improve the appearance of aging skin, enhance facial contours, and add volume to areas like the lips and cheeks.
